Name: Strike
Description: Deal 14 damage.

Name: Pierce
Description: Deal 16 damage straight past Guards, Decoys and Mirages.

Name: Shockwave
Description: Deal 10 damage to the rival and 10 to each of their field cards. Ignores Guards.

Name: Charged Blow
Description: Deal 20 damage. Deals 10 more if you still have 5 or more Libido after paying.

Name: Sting
Description: Deal 6 damage and poison the rival: 4 damage at the start of each of their next 3 turns.

Name: Rot
Description: For 3 turns, the rival cannot heal and poison hurts them twice as much.

Name: Mark
Description: Mark the rival. The next damage they take is 50 percent higher.

Name: Snare
Description: Hidden. The next field card the rival plays takes 15 damage as it lands.

Name: Bastion
Description: A Guard with 30 Resolve. Attacks must break it before they can reach you.

Name: Thorn Ward
Description: A Guard with 18 Resolve. Whoever strikes it takes 6 damage back.

Name: Card Lock
Description: Lock the last card the rival played. It rests 2 extra turns.

Name: Shackle
Description: The rival's next card costs 3 more Libido.

Name: Ransom
Description: Steal 2 Libido from the rival.

Name: Dispel
Description: Destroy a rival field card with 15 Resolve or less. If there is none, wipe all of the rival's effects.

Name: Copy
Description: Play a copy of the last card the rival played, as your own.

Name: Paralysis
Description: Hidden. In 2 turns, the rival loses a turn.

Name: Reflect
Description: Hidden. The next attack card played at you bounces back at the rival.

Name: Return to Sender
Description: Hidden. The next field card the rival plays is sent back to their hand and rests 2 turns.

Name: Clause
Description: While it stands, the rival takes 4 damage every time they play a card. 15 Resolve.

Name: Null Zone
Description: While it stands, no Omen can trigger or count down, on either side. 20 Resolve.

Name: Glimpse
Description: Reveal the rival's next planned card and turn their hidden Omens face up.

Name: Read the Hand
Description: Reveal the rival's planned card and their Omens. If they play that card next anyway, it fizzles.

Name: Stillframe
Description: Freeze the rival. They lose their next turn.

Name: Rewind
Description: Undo the Body and Ego you lost during the rival's last turn.

Name: Coin Toss
Description: Flip a coin. Heads: deal 24 damage. Tails: you take 8.

Name: Counter Fate
Description: Hidden. The next attack card played at you is cancelled.

Name: Long Echo
Description: Hidden. In 2 turns, your last Instant card plays again for free.

Name: Decoy
Description: A Guard with 12 Resolve. Each attack on it has a 50 percent chance to pass through harmlessly.

Name: Mirage Field
Description: While it stands, each rival attack has a 30 percent chance to miss. 15 Resolve.

Name: Loaded Die
Description: At the start of each of your turns, roll a die: 1 to 3 deals 4, 4 or 5 deals 8, a 6 deals 16. 12 Resolve.

Name: Patch
Description: Heal 10 Body.

Name: Drain Touch
Description: Deal 12 damage and heal 6 Body.

Name: Sap
Description: The rival loses 3 Libido.

Name: Intimidate
Description: Deal 15 Ego damage. At 0 Ego the rival breaks and loses a turn.

Name: Panic
Description: Deal 10 Ego damage. The rival's next card has a 30 percent chance to fizzle.

Name: Nightmare
Description: Hidden. In 2 turns, the rival takes 30 Ego damage.

Name: Phoenix Seed
Description: Hidden. For 3 turns, if your Body would hit 0, you rise again with 30.

Name: Regrow
Description: Heal 6 Body at the start of each of your turns. 15 Resolve.

Name: Battery
Description: Gain 1 extra Libido at the start of each of your turns. 10 Resolve.

Name: Despair
Description: The rival loses 8 Ego at the start of each of your turns. 18 Resolve.

Name: Understudy
Description: Juno's card. A Guard with 40 Resolve that takes the hits meant for you.
